name: Frankencoin
oneLiner: ZCHF is Frankencoin's decentralized Swiss-franc stablecoin, minted from overcollateralized auction-priced positions in ETH, BTC, LSTs, and gold tokens.
collateral: ETH, BTC derivatives (WBTC, cbBTC), ETH LSTs (wstETH, LsETH), gold tokens (PAXG, XAUt), tokenized RWAs (SPYon, LENDS, REALU), and governance tokens (CRV, GNO) in oracle-free overcollateralized positions; any collateral can be whitelisted by governance
pegMechanism: Auction-based collateral valuation with veto governance; no price oracle dependency

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: ZCHF resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: Frankencoin has no owner; minting is performed by minter plugins and positions that pass the protocol's veto-governed minter registry.

controls.label: Frankencoin minter registry
controls.capDescription: Approved minters and their registered positions can mint; new minters are subject to the application period and qualified pool-share holder veto.
controls.evidence: Source review showed suggestMinter, denyMinter, registerPosition, mintWithReserve, and mint guarded by minterOnly; no owner() was present. Contract comments describe arbitrary minting plugins accepted unless qualified pool-share holders veto.

review.evidence: Frankencoin source supports a governed minter-plugin model rather than issuer owner minting.

notices.title: Single-name equity concentration (BOSS)
notices.message: BOSS (Boss Info AG, a Swiss-listed IT/consulting equity) is currently the largest collateral line in the Frankencoin protocol at roughly one-third of total backing. Single-name corporate equity introduces issuer- and liquidity-specific risk distinct from the protocol's BTC, ETH, and gold collateral; positions are managed under Frankencoin's veto governance and remain subject to challenge auctions.
